title: Store Themes Overview
description: Overview of all available store themes in Matjrii, including industry-specific designs and customization options.
content:
Store Themes Overview

Matjrii offers 10+ professional store themes designed for different industries. Each theme is fully customizable and mobile-responsive.

Available Themes

Matjrii includes themes for various industries:

  • Fashion: Clothing, accessories, jewelry
  • Electronics: Tech products, gadgets
  • Furniture: Home decor, furniture
  • Beauty & Cosmetics: Skincare, makeup
  • Baby & Kids: Children's products
  • Jewelry: Fine jewelry, watches
  • Perfume & Fragrances: Fragrance products
  • Cars & Automotive: Auto parts, accessories
  • Watches: Timepieces
  • Default: General purpose

Theme Features

All themes include:

  • Responsive design (mobile, tablet, desktop)
  • Modern, clean layouts
  • Fast loading times
  • SEO optimized
  • Customizable colors and fonts
  • Multiple layout options
  • Product showcase sections
  • Blog integration
  • Newsletter integration
  • Social media integration

Choosing a Theme

When selecting a theme, consider:

  • Your industry
  • Product type
  • Brand style
  • Layout preferences
  • Color scheme
  • Feature requirements

Theme Preview

Before applying a theme:

  • Preview themes in demo mode
  • See how your products look
  • Test on different devices
  • Check all features

Applying a Theme

To apply a theme:

  1. Navigate to Store Settings → Themes
  2. Browse available themes
  3. Preview the theme
  4. Click "Apply Theme"
  5. Customize as needed

Theme Customization

Customize your theme:

  • Colors and branding
  • Typography
  • Layout options
  • Header and footer
  • Homepage sections
  • Product page layout
  • Category page layout

Switching Themes

You can switch themes at any time:

  • Your products and content remain
  • Some settings may need adjustment
  • Preview before switching
  • Test thoroughly after switching

Mobile Responsiveness

All themes are mobile-responsive:

  • Optimized for mobile devices
  • Touch-friendly navigation
  • Fast mobile loading
  • Mobile checkout optimization

Performance

Themes are optimized for:

  • Fast page load times
  • SEO best practices
  • Accessibility standards
  • Cross-browser compatibility

Best Practices

  • Choose a theme that matches your brand
  • Preview before applying
  • Customize to your needs
  • Test on all devices
  • Keep customization minimal for performance
  • Update theme when available
